LanguageData.FAF_SteadyDesc: Reduce the up-and-down motion while hovering. Rotation is controlled separately.
LanguageData.FAF_AngularSpeedDesc: Adjust how quickly this freezer turns, in either direction.
LanguageData.FAF_PortableCabinetsDesc: Manage the freezers carried by this character or caravan.
LanguageData.FAF_StorageRejected: Cannot transfer. Check the storage filter, stack space, total weight limit and whether a sleeping pad is fitted.
LanguageData.FAF_EmptyCabinet: No matching items inside this freezer.
LanguageData.FAF_NoOrdinaryInventory: No matching pawn/caravan items. A packed freezer on the ground can eject contents here, but map items must be physically hauled in.
LanguageData.FAF_MapServiceUnavailable: Reconnecting power and taking out bottled coolant require an installed freezer. Stored coolant can still be used; adding it from carried supplies is a separate operation.
LanguageData.FAF_RapidThermalDesc: Increase thermal output and electricity use; backup coolant use rises only when cooling.
LanguageData.FAF_RefuelLaunchDesc: Manually refill the tank for maneuvering, using the shared refill target. This does not turn on temperature control, coolant backup or automatic supply.
LanguageData.FAF_MapJumpDesc: Move this freezer, along with its cargo and occupant, up to {0} cells on this map; it can also move empty. Choose an explored, unroofed footprint with sufficient terrain support and valid construction and interaction space. Landing must not remove or destroy existing objects.
LanguageData.FAF_UnloadBeforeJump: Finish or cancel outstanding loading first. Only an occupant permitted by the current retrofit can accompany this move.
LanguageData.FAF_InvalidCabinet: The freezer is no longer accessible, player-owned or eligible for this action.
LanguageData.FAF_InvalidCaravan: The player caravan is no longer available.
LanguageData.FAF_InvalidSleeper: Only one sleeper accepted by the original Nivarian fridge-bed rules may accompany this move.
LanguageData.FAF_Cooldown: The freezer's pulse system is still recovering.
LanguageData.FAF_OutOfRange: The destination is outside the allowed range or is the current location.
LanguageData.FAF_RoofBlocked: Clear the roof above the freezer's entire footprint first.
LanguageData.FAF_InvalidLanding: The full landing footprint must be within the map, explored, unroofed and supported, with valid construction and interaction space.
LanguageData.FAF_NotEnoughCoolant: At least one freezer does not have enough coolant.
LanguageData.FAF_OverMass: The net payload is too heavy. Stored goods, sleeping pads, occupants, equipment and cargo count toward the limit; this freezer's shell does not.
LanguageData.FAF_NotEnoughSeats: One passenger per freezer: the complete party needs enough valid freezers. Dead or destroyed passengers cannot board.
LanguageData.FAF_FinishLoading: Finish loading and have all travellers board before departure.
LanguageData.FAF_ManifestChanged: The travellers or goods have changed. Choose the journey again.
LanguageData.FAF_InvalidDestination: No suitable arrival is available there. Choose another destination.
LanguageData.FAF_LaunchNotReady: Launch is not ready: check completed loading, one berth per passenger, mass, roof and pulse cooldown.
LanguageData.FAF_LaunchDesc: Fly the loaded freezer group to its destination. At most one living occupant per freezer; {0} kg net payload per unit, excluding its shell. Maximum atmospheric range: {1} tiles. Occupants stay inside after landing.
LanguageData.FAF_LaunchCaravanDesc: Use all carried freezers as one-person berths. Every caravan member and item must fit; otherwise nobody departs. Each freezer keeps its own contents and resource state.
LanguageData.FAF_LaunchConfirm: Send {0} occupants in {1} freezers for {2} coolant in total? Each freezer uses its own tank. Occupants remain inside after landing.
LanguageData.FAF_CommitFailed: The move did not complete. Check the error log.
LanguageData.FAF_PowerSwitchPending: A colonist must operate the installed switch. Click again to cancel the pending change. A carried freezer switches directly.
LanguageData.FAF_NativeInventoryHint: For ordinary caravan food, medicine and trade, take the required items out of the freezer first.
LanguageData.FAF_UnloadBeforePacking: Unload the transport bay and cancel unfinished loading before uninstalling or reinstalling. Refrigerated contents can stay inside.
LanguageData.FAF_MapJumpBoardedDesc: Move this freezer, along with its cargo and occupant, up to {0} cells on this map; it can also move empty. Choose an explored, unroofed footprint with sufficient terrain support and valid construction and interaction space. Landing must not remove or destroy existing objects.
LanguageData.FAF_JumpSleeperNotice: The sleeper's rest ends for this move. The freezer's bed can be used again after landing.
LanguageData.FAF_JumpBoardedNotice: The occupant stays aboard. Riding inside does not grant a bed or sleep benefits.
LanguageData.FAF_InvalidBoardedPassenger: The boarded passenger is no longer a living, valid transport occupant.
LanguageData.FAF_UnpackPassengers: A living pawn is carried inside another passenger or cargo holder. Unpack and board each passenger separately; each needs its own freezer berth.
LanguageData.FAF_NeedsCaravanOwner: Load at least one living player caravan owner before launch. An uncrewed launch cannot form a caravan.
LanguageData.FAF_RecoveryCreated: Some freezer payload could not be delivered. Its original freezers, cargo and remains are preserved at a freezer recovery point. Send another player caravan to collect them.
LanguageData.FAF_RecoveryPartial: Some payload was not accepted by the caravan and remains at the recovery point.
LanguageData.FAF_RecoveryCabinetDesc: Open the freezer's temperature controls. Energy is still used and food can still spoil while waiting here; the recovery point provides no supplies.
LanguageData.FAF_PodPlacementBlocked: Some payload could not be placed and remains safely inside this pod. Clear nearby cells, then retry unloading. Removing the pod preserves its remaining payload at a world recovery point.
LanguageData.FAF_CargoManagementDesc: Manage this freezer's stored goods and its actual occupants.
LanguageData.FAF_TransportCargoHint: Passengers are shown above. Use the loading orders to change the transport cargo.
LanguageData.FAF_CargoExternalReadOnly: Goods cannot be transferred outside in the current situation.
LanguageData.FAF_CargoActionUnavailable: This action is not available here.
LanguageData.FAF_PayloadReadOnly: These people and goods remain here. No single freezer can currently be assigned to them; viewing does not move them.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewEmptyAutonomous: No occupants. Cargo can travel on a route that supports autonomous flight.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewOverCapacity: More than one occupant is present. Everyone is retained; resolve the extra occupancy before further boarding or departure.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewEntryMapOnly: Boarding must be arranged at an installed freezer on the map.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewNoCandidates: No available characters are on this map.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewBedRule: Only eligible Nivarians can sleep in this freezer. Riding inside does not grant a bed or sleep benefits.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewAutonomyReady: Autonomous flight is available; the chosen route must still be suitable.
LanguageData.FAF_EnvironmentLoad: Environment demand {0} W · total demand {1} W
LanguageData.FAF_EnvironmentCaution: Vacuum level is not an oxygen gauge or a guarantee of a safe temperature. Environment protection needs electricity; coolant only cools. When power is short, environment protection takes priority.
LanguageData.FAF_AngularZeroHint: Zero holds the current angle. Turning rotation off returns the freezer upright.
LanguageData.FAF_AngularInvalidHint: Enter a number from −90 to +90 degrees per second. This input has not been applied.
LanguageData.FAF_BoardingLocked: Passenger boarding requires the completed SALT retrofit.
LanguageData.FAF_NoSafeExit: There is no safe place beside the freezer. The occupant will remain inside.
LanguageData.FAF_NoPendingBoarder: This character has no pending boarding arrangement here.
LanguageData.FAF_CruiseUnavailable: New freezer flights are unavailable in this game version. Check the error log.
LanguageData.FAF_AtmosphereRequired: Complete CREAM before a space route.
LanguageData.FAF_WorldFlightEstimate: Estimated world flight: {0} (takeoff and landing extra)
LanguageData.FAF_MapQuote: Distance {0}/{1} cells · coolant {2}\nRotate with the building rotation keys.
LanguageData.FAF_MapQuoteBudget: Hard range {0} cells · coolant range {1}\nDistance {2} · cost {3} · coolant afterwards {4}\nRotate with the building rotation keys.
LanguageData.FAF_WorldQuoteBudget: Hard range {0} target-layer tiles · coolant range {1}\nDistance {2} · group cost {3} · group coolant afterwards {4}
LanguageData.FAF_RestingOverCapacity: More than one character is inside. Everyone remains here; resolve the extra occupancy before arranging another use.
LanguageData.FAF_RestingBedRule: Only eligible Nivarians can rest in this freezer.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewRestMapOnly: Rest can be arranged only at an installed freezer on a map.
LanguageData.FAF_CrewActionFailed: The arrangement could not be completed. Check the current conditions and try again.
LanguageData.FAF_BedUnavailable: This character cannot use the freezer bed right now.
LanguageData.FAF_ActualElectricalUseUnknown: Actual electrical use: awaiting a reading
LanguageData.FAF_ActualElectricalUseDetails:
Thermal control {0} W
Atmosphere {1} W
Battery self-discharge {2} W
Excludes charging and power supplied to other devices.
LanguageData.FAF_CancelArrangementsDesc: Cancel unfinished boarding and loading orders for this freezer group. Occupants and cargo already aboard remain inside; use the crew controls to leave.
LanguageData.FAF_UnsafeExitConfirm: The selected exit is hazardous: temperature {0}, vacuum {1}. Leave the freezer anyway?
LanguageData.FAF_AbandonStationDesc: Allow this empty freezer to stop retaining the orbital map.
LanguageData.FAF_EmptyBeforeAbandon: Remove all occupants, cargo and pending rest arrangements first.
LanguageData.FAF_LoadSelectionNoBerth: No free berth: each freezer holds at most one living occupant, including animals. Occupants, sleepers and valid boarding or rest arrangements use that berth. Deselect a passenger, cancel an arrangement, or add an eligible freezer.
LanguageData.FAF_LandingWouldDestroy: Landing would remove or destroy {0}. Choose another spot or clear it yourself first.
LanguageData.FAF_LeaveFreezerDesc: Let the current user leave this freezer, ending any rest. Cargo, the sleeping pad and stored coolant remain inside. Hazardous outside conditions still require confirmation.
LanguageData.FAF_QuickDisembarkDesc: Let the selected living occupant leave this freezer. Cargo, the sleeping pad and stored coolant remain inside. Hazardous outside conditions still require confirmation.
LanguageData.FAF_QuickExitChooseOne: There are {0} current users. Choose one to leave; everyone else remains inside.
